Container.Name: ChromeTuner
Container.Overview:
Single-tuner virtual HDHomeRun. Plays a web page in Chrome on a virtual display and serves the screen and audio as MPEG-TS (H.264 via NVENC + AAC) for Emby Live TV.
Channels: edit /config/channels.yaml (live, no restart). Emby: add an HDHomeRun tuner at http://[IP]:5004, or an M3U tuner at http://[IP]:5004/playlist.m3u. Guide: XMLTV at http://[IP]:5004/epg.xml. Sign in to sites: WebUI page, "Open in tuner browser", then use noVNC on port 6080.
Container.Requires: Nvidia Driver plugin (for NVENC). Falls back to CPU x264 without it.

Config.Name: noVNC
Config.Description: Remote view of the tuner's Chrome, for signing in to sites.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: channels.yaml, scripts and the Chrome profile (logins).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID for NVENC (8GB RTX 3060, shared with Emby/Frigate/Immich).

Config.Name: Idle timeout
Config.Description: Seconds after the last viewer leaves before the tuner stops.

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: Optional password for noVNC. Blank = no password (LAN only).

Config.Name: Debug
Config.Description: Set to 1 for verbose logs (ffmpeg, Chrome).

Config.Name: Emby URL
Config.Description: Emby server URL, used to trigger a guide refresh when the YouTube TV channel changes.

Config.Name: Emby API key
Config.Description: Emby API key (Dashboard > Advanced > API Keys).

Config.Name: Start page
Config.Description: Page the tuner browser opens on start.

Config.Name: Pushover app token
Config.Description: Pushover application token for channel-lock watchdog alerts (optional).

Config.Name: Pushover user key
Config.Description: Pushover user (or group) key for watchdog alerts (optional).
